name: Party Mode
description: Standalone full-screen Party queue, MA guest QR and native audio visualizations, with independent visibility and HA actions.
author: Local Kiosk Satellite project

settings.title: Speaker / højttaler
settings.description: Music Assistant HA media_player for the speaker group whose queue Party should follow.

settings.title: Start automatically when visibility allows
settings.description: Otherwise use Party start/stop actions. Independent of all screensavers and other plugin visibility.

settings.title: Only while playing
settings.description: Also gate Party on the selected speaker playback state.

settings.title: Allow while paused
settings.description: Used when Only while playing is enabled.

settings.title: Visibility entity (optional)
settings.description: Optional Home Assistant entity that controls whether this overlay is allowed to appear.

settings.title: Visibility condition
settings.description: Active recognizes on, true, home, playing, open, detected, occupied and present. Time between does not need an entity.

settings.title: Visibility value
settings.description: Value for the condition. Examples: on, 30, 10..200, or 22:00-06:00.

settings.title: Screen controls
settings.description: All controls shows Settings and Close at the top. HA actions always work, including when screen controls are hidden.

settings.title: Visualization
settings.description: None / Neon Spectrum / Mirror Spectrum / Radial Pulse / Waveform / Star Particles / Neon Tunnel. Actions can save another choice.

settings.title: Party visualization gain
settings.description: Independent Party visual strength. Does not change audio volume.

settings.title: Party refresh rate
settings.description: Party rendering and audio-frame rate. Independent of the normal spectrum overlay.

settings.title: Show full queue
settings.description: Otherwise keep a small current-song card for more visual space.

settings.title: Show MA guest QR
settings.description: Follows MA guest access for the same configured group. Hiding QR does not disable MA guest access.

commands.title: Party guest QR: follow Music Assistant (saved)
Party guests: enable access in Music Assistant
Party guests: disable access in Music Assistant
